rows.label: tlk70000052_01_msg0001
rows.name:
Adel-sama has been so kind to
me ever since we first met.

rows.label: tlk70000052_01_msg0002
rows.name:
Like when I was cleaning the roof of
the mansion and slipped and fell.

rows.label: tlk70000052_01_msg0003
rows.name:
When I got shocked in the
kitchen, he worried and
nursed me at the manor.

rows.label: tlk70000052_01_msg0004
rows.name: Well, I wasn't hurt at all, though!

rows.label: tlk70000052_01_msg0005
rows.name:
If anything, Adel-sama suffered far
worse injuries! That's how I learned
so much about medicinal herbs.

rows.label: tlk70000052_01_msg0006
rows.name:
Adel-sama, I know I'm one to talk, but
don't push yourself too hard, okay?
You only have one life!
